verdict.rationale: Requesty's gateway explicitly documents policy-based mid-task model switching: Fallback Policies reroute on failure/timeout/error, Load Balancing Policies distribute by weight for cost/rollout optimization while pinning sticky sessions, and Latency-Based Routing picks the fastest model in real time — all applied transparently via routing rules without app code changes. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of these policies working in production, and no explicit example of capability-based (not just cost/latency/failure) switching rule.
